next_build.gap: The project has no inspectable, attributable evidence chain connecting a real user task to a bounded Agent workflow, evaluation results, failures, and a product decision.
next_build.why_now: One bounded end-to-end evaluation-and-decision evidence package would address the JD's highest-value evaluation, failure-analysis, Agent reliability, and tradeoff requirements while preserving ownership boundaries. A documentation-only ownership memo is the rejected runner-up because it would clarify attribution but would not demonstrate product or technical judgment.
steps: Have a downstream working Agent inspect the existing project goals, architecture, workflows, known failures, tests, and safety boundaries before proposing implementation details.

Choose one current, product-relevant project-analysis task and compare the existing Agent behavior with a simple non-Agent baseline on a small versioned case set; define human review, failure labels, stop or ask behavior, and safety boundaries from the inspected system.
Return an exploration brief for product-owner approval and stop before implementation; only after explicit approval, implement and verify the approved evaluation direction.

Report changed files, commands, exact results, reviewer judgments and disagreements, remaining limitations, produced artifacts, and attributable ownership; do not invent metrics, users, outcomes, ownership, or test results.
acceptance_criteria: A source-linked user task and limitation justify why the chosen evaluation is product-relevant.
Versioned cases, baseline, rubric, failure taxonomy, and decision rules are inspectable.
Executed results include bad cases and preserve genuine human judgments and disagreements where subjective quality matters.
At least one result causes a documented keep, revise, or stop decision, with Agent stop or ask and safety boundaries tested where applicable.
Artifacts distinguish personal, shared, and system contributions and state remaining unvalidated claims.
next_build.expected_evidence: An approved evaluation brief; versioned cases and baseline; human-review rubric and records; executed results and bad cases; reliability or safety traces; a decision log linking results to one product change; and ownership attribution.
next_build.output_dependency: Only completed evidence may update D1, D3-D8, D10, JD match, project highlights, resume bullets, Q1/Q3/Q4/Q5/Q6 answers, and mock follow-up defenses; the current match does not improve from this proposal.
next_build.interview_question_unlocked: Which failure in your Agent evaluation changed the product, and how did you decide whether to revise, stop, or ship?
